para_examples.original: Statement: We're committed to sustainable pricing that keeps margins healthy for both firms, so let's avoid a race to the bottom and settle into prices that work for everyone.
para_examples.delivered: We intend to keep prices at a sustainable level that preserves healthy margins for both companies, so let's steer clear of a downward spiral and agree on figures that work for everyone.

para_examples.original: Statement: We intend to keep prices reasonable and stable so both firms can earn healthy margins across all rounds.
para_examples.delivered: We aim to hold prices at sensible, steady levels so that both companies can secure solid margins throughout every round.

para_examples.original: Statement: We see your signal about sensible margins, and we're prepared to keep prices at levels that let both firms earn a healthy return, though we'll adjust if you undercut us.
para_examples.delivered: We're receiving your message about reasonable margins, and we're willing to hold our prices at levels that allow both companies to make a solid profit, but we'll respond with changes if you cut your prices below ours.

para_examples.original: Statement: We've seen that holding prices up benefits both of us, so I propose we keep our prices at this level and avoid any undercutting.
para_examples.delivered: Since we've both come to see that keeping prices elevated works in our mutual favor, I suggest we maintain them at their current level and refrain from any undercutting.
